title: Metrovpn v2.7.6 Speed Test Upgrade
message: Upgrades the built-in Speed Test to a multi-connection steady-state engine (8 parallel TCP/HTTP1.1 download streams + 6 parallel upload streams with warm-up exclusion and Ookla-style trimmed sampling, warmed keep-alive ping & jitter, and a 0-1000+ Mbps nonlinear speedometer arc) so high-speed fiber connections match Ookla Speedtest & Fast.com.
